stories.title: Trump touts preliminary deal to end the war with Iran in press conference
stories.summary: President Trump gave a wide-ranging press conference Wednesday at the end of the G7 summit where he tackled questions about his tentative agreement with Iran.

stories.title: Many Iranians feel betrayed by the looming deal to end the war
stories.summary: Anti-regime protesters feel the U.S. abandoned them after having promised support.

stories.title: Outreach workers weigh the risks of forcing homeless vets to get help
stories.summary: More than 30,000 US military veterans are homeless. The Trump Administration has promised new housing for vets, but one of Trump's executive orders is targeting homeless people.

stories.title: Las Culturistas Culture Awards take the elitism out of awards shows
stories.summary: NPR's Ailsa Chang talks with Matt Rogers and Bowen Yang of the Las Culturistas podcast about their tongue-in-cheek "Culture Awards" broadcast.

stories.title: Uzbekistan's first World Cup appearance is a dream come true for players and fans
stories.summary: The World Cup debut of Uzbekistan signals the region's growing confidence on the global stage and, some argue, the arrival of a "golden generation" making its mark in sports, culture and science.

stories.title: Rising utility bills in Tucson have locals suspicious of data centers
stories.summary: Nationwide peoples electric bills are up an average of 30% in the last five years. A big rate increase in Tucson has locals blaming a new data center.
